stories.who: the World Trade Organization, the body that oversees the rules of trade between countries
stories.what: raised its forecast for growth in world goods trade this year to three point nine percent from one point nine percent in spring, because trade in A I goods such as chips and servers rose sixty seven percent in the first half of the year and made up nearly half of all goods trade growth, offsetting the hit to oil and gas shipments from the Middle East war; it is an official forecast

stories.who: Deep Robotics, a Chinese robot maker, and its DR02 human-shaped robots
stories.what: says it ran street trials in early October in Hangzhou, China, in which the robots directed traffic at junctions with hand signals, moved around the junctions on their own, kept order and answered tourists' questions in several languages, in heavy traffic and steady rain; every claim is the company's, with no results or official comment
stories.why_for_people: routine street jobs like directing traffic and guiding visitors could pass to machines, freeing staff for work that needs human judgment, though only the company describes the test and gives no results
stories.script: Next, robotics. Chinese firm Deep Robotics says its human-shaped robots directed traffic on real streets, so routine jobs like this could pass to machines.

stories.who: researchers at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, a Boston hospital, working with Google, and AMIE, Google's medical chatbot
stories.what: report in The Lancet that the chatbot questioned patients by text at home before urgent primary-care appointments and wrote a summary for the doctor; a physician watched every chat, and none of the ninety eight completed chats needed a safety stop, though one hallucination was logged; the study tested only whether this is workable, not whether it improves health, and Google's parent Alphabet paid for it
stories.why_for_people: a sign A I could safely start a doctor's visit by asking the first questions while a doctor watches, though the small trial was Google-funded, ran at one hospital and shows no health gain
stories.script: In health. A Google chatbot questioned patients before urgent visits in a small doctor-watched trial, a sign A I could safely start a doctor's visit.
